folds.name: two_releases
folds.rule: AC-1 journal: R1 and R2 released, nothing superseded

folds.name: ac1_supersede
folds.rule: AC-1: superseded_by(R1) is R2 and R1's entry stays released

folds.name: more_releases
folds.rule: a W2 output and the tombstone are not releases

folds.name: chain
folds.rule: R2 may itself be superseded later

folds.name: two_old_one_new
folds.rule: one new record may replace two old ones

folds.name: on_trial
folds.rule: (e) a supersession counts on its own branch

folds.name: forged_agent
folds.rule: (a) the principal is human

folds.name: forged_script
folds.rule: (a) the principal is human

folds.name: forged_bus_route
folds.rule: (a) the handler added the event

folds.name: forged_class_w2
folds.rule: (a) the entry is W3

folds.name: forged_major_2
folds.rule: (a) the command is major 1

folds.name: forged_other_command
folds.rule: (b) RecordSuperseded only from journal.supersede_record@1

folds.name: forged_with_request_filed
folds.rule: (c) no Request* event next to it

folds.name: forged_with_request_approved
folds.rule: (c) an approved request does not carry a supersession

folds.name: forged_stale_head
folds.rule: (d) head is the branch head before the entry

folds.name: forged_made_up_head
folds.rule: (d) head is the branch head before the entry

folds.name: replayed_event
folds.rule: (d) the same event replayed later is refused

folds.name: concurrent_pair
folds.rule: (d) two supersessions decided against the same head

folds.name: forged_other_branch
folds.rule: (e) R1 and R2 are not released on trial

folds.name: forged_promoted_copy
folds.rule: (e) a promoted copy never carries a supersession

folds.name: two_events
folds.rule: one RecordSuperseded per entry

folds.name: extra_key
folds.rule: exactly the keys head, new, old

folds.name: missing_key
folds.rule: exactly the keys head, new, old

folds.name: not_a_digest
folds.rule: every value a digest

folds.name: uppercase_digest
folds.rule: lowercase digests

folds.name: body_not_object
folds.rule: the body is an object

folds.name: no_reason_commit
folds.rule: the header records a reason commitment

folds.name: self_supersession
folds.rule: old and new differ

folds.name: old_not_released
folds.rule: a W2 output is not a released record

folds.name: new_not_released
folds.rule: new is a released record

folds.name: tombstone_not_released
folds.rule: the tombstone is not a record

folds.name: old_already_superseded
folds.rule: old not yet superseded

folds.name: new_already_superseded
folds.rule: new must not be superseded

folds.name: supersede_outputs_are_not_releases
folds.rule: a supersession entry's outputs release nothing

folds.name: refusal_is_fatal
folds.rule: (f) the fold stops at the first refused entry
